items.title: SpaceX signs $1.1 billion-per month computing deal
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian joins Market Domination host Ines Ferré to report that SpaceX (SPCX) has signed a $1.1 billion-per month AI computing deal. The move will bring the company closer to its $100 billion annual recurring revenue target this year, according to CFO Bret Johnson.

items.title: Nvidia Is Letting Rival AI Chips Into Its Racks. Astera Labs Could Be the Quiet Winner
items.summary: NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) is doing something that initially sounds counterintuitive: making it easier for competing AI accelerators to live inside Nvidia-designed systems. Reuters reported September 10 that inference-chip startup d-Matrix will use Nvidia’s NVLink Fusion technology to connect its next-generation Raptor processors directly into Nvidia data-center racks.
